name: Aura Consolidated Group, Inc.
summary: Aura Consolidated Group, Inc. engages in the business of global digital safety and security industries, including consumer identity protection and digital safety, employee and business cybersecurity, family digital safety and parental controls, and education technology and student digital safety and wellbeing. Its online solutions include credit monitoring, identity theft protection, identity theft insurance, online data removal, VPN and online privacy, antivirus, password manager and vault, and spam call protection. The company was founded by Hari Krishna Ravichandran in 2017 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
